sql.systemList.getSystemListsForCompany: select sl.id, sl.system_list, sl.archived, csl.company_id, csl.id as company_system_list_id, sl.has_sub_options from flow.company_system_list csl inner join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where csl.company_id = :companyId order by sl.system_list
